subject: warning massage : Dropping 1 individuals with missing phenotypes

messages.author: ca77848d1fce7fe3
messages.subject: warning massage : Dropping 1 individuals with missing phenotypes
parts:
Hello 
  
I have 3 column  as  phenotypic data first column is ID , second and third are phenotypic measurements. 

when i run the script : 
out.hk <- scanone(QTL_root_length_TREATMENT,pheno.col=2, method="hk")
 
I receive  this warning : 

Warning message:
In checkcovar(cross, pheno.col, addcovar, intcovar, perm.strata,  :
  Dropping 1 individuals with missing phenotypes.

but when I run the same script for "pheno.col=3" I didn't receive this warning. 
 
I want to know what is the problem of my data. and what is the meaning of this warning. 

 thank you in advance

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] warning massage : Dropping 1 individuals with missing phenotypes
parts:
phenotype 2 has an individual with a missing value; that individual is omitted in the qtl analysis. phenotype 3 does not have any missing data. 

karl
